title: Law to ease fire rules for e-bike charging areas
summary: This bill removes the requirement that battery charging areas for powered mobility devices like e-bikes be separated by a fire-rated barrier from repair or servicing areas. Instead, it creates a separate fire code section requiring only a 3-foot separation from repair areas and from motor vehicles, along with other existing safety measures like ventilation and fire extinguishers. The law would take effect 180 days after becoming law.
